original_text: Niranjan Das is a prominent figure in both the Ravidassia religion and the field of engineering. He is the head of Dera Sach Khand and has been a leader in the Ravidassia community since 2010. His leadership was further solidified after he survived a violent attack in Vienna, which resulted in gunshot wounds and the death of his deputy. Despite these challenges, he continues to be a significant figure in the Ravidassia community and has received Z level security from the Punjab police.
